headers.$comment: The menu backdrop. NOT immutable: tools/make-brand.mjs rewrites press-rome-line-1440.webp over press-rome-line-1440.webp, so a year would pin a visitor to whatever frames they first saw. A day, with a month of stale-while-revalidate, means a returning player pays nothing and a re-shot set reaches them within a day. Without a rule here these fall to Vercel's default and a returning visitor revalidates 236 kB on every load. Carried over from the superseded e/ui/cinematic-menu branch, which reached the same conclusion about its own plates.
